summary: Two people on their way to meet for coffee find a rally taking place downtown.
realLife: owner, Nov 15: A planned outing can bring the player into contact with a public event already underway.
inGame: needs: join a planned outing to an existing public-action rally at the same place and time.
gates: The route and time coincide with a recorded rally.

turns.what: The two pause long enough to identify the speaker and then continue to coffee.
turns.pulledBy: Their appointment leaves little time to stay.
turns.writesBack: They can recall the speaker but did not hear the whole address.
